node.statement: Under the added hypotheses of 1.5.1, the external unit-control theorem applies directly to B:=B_U oplus B_V, A:=A_R, and the assumed extended delta-isomorphism v; no existence claim is imported from 1.3. Its conclusion is ||v(I_B)-I_A||<=C_iso_unit*(delta+epsilon_{A_R}). Since I_A=u_{A_R}, delta<=K*t, and epsilon_{A_R}<=t, this is at most C_iso_unit*(K+1)*t<=abs(C_iso_unit)*(K+1)*t<=D_3*t, the final constant comparison being the validated choice in 1.1. Conversely, absent the explicitly assumed v, this argument has no instance; thus the current root remains unproved exactly as 1.3 and 1.5 state.
